# Match country names to their equivalent naturalearth WKT polygons

Match country names to their equivalent naturalearth WKT polygons using
[`rnaturalearth::ne_countries()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rnaturalearth/reference/ne_countries.html).

## Usage

``` r
match_countries(countrynames, returnmulti = TRUE, onlywkt = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

- countrynames:

  a vector of country names to match to naturalearth.

- returnmulti:

  return the GBIF taxon ids only (otherwise return the full lookup
  dataframe).

- onlywkt:

  only return location_wkt (see note for more details).

## Value

A list containing:

- `$location_wkt`: a multipolygon containing all locations (or a named
  vector of individual country polygons).

- `$missing_locs`: any provided countries not found in naturalearth.

- `$found_locs`: any provided countries that were found in naturalearth.

## Author

Francis Windram

## Examples

``` r
match_countries(c("United Kingdom", "Germany"))
```
